readme:
# France Travail Job Scraper

Scrape job listings from **France Travail** (formerly Pole Emploi), France's public employment service with 500,000+ active job listings. Extract title, company, location, contract type, salary, and full description.

HTTP-only scraper using Cheerio (no browser). Runs at 128MB memory.

---

## Scraper d'offres d'emploi France Travail

Scrapez les offres d'emploi de **France Travail** (anciennement Pole Emploi), le service public de l'emploi en France avec plus de 500 000 offres actives. Extrayez le titre, l'entreprise, la localisation, le type de contrat, le salaire et la description complete.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client -- Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/france-travail-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `france-travail-scraper` to scrape job listings from france travail. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Features

- **500,000+ active listings** from France's largest public job board
- **Multi-query support** -- run multiple search keywords in one execution, deduplicated
- **Title filter** -- `titleFilter` drops non-matching SERP rows before detail fetch (saves cost)
- **Sort by newest or relevance** -- `sortBy: "newest"` (default) maps to France Travail's `tri=1`; `"relevance"` maps to `tri=0`
- **Date filter** -- `postedWithinDays` maps to France Travail's `emission` param (1, 3, 7, 14, or 31 days)
- **Employment type filter** -- `employmentType: "FULL_TIME"` maps to `dureeHebdo=1` (temps plein); `"PART_TIME"` maps to `dureeHebdo=2` (temps partiel)
- **SERP + Detail modes** -- fast SERP-only or full detail extraction with salary and remote info
- **French contract types** -- CDI, CDD, interim, alternance, stage
- **Remote detection** -- detects teletravail (remote work) mentions
- **Salary parsing** -- structured min/max from French salary formats (annuel, mensuel, horaire)
- **Location filtering** -- filter by department code (75 = Paris, 69 = Lyon, etc.)
- **Low cost** -- 128MB memory, HTTP-only

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `searchQueries` | array | `["developpeur"]` | One or more search keywords. Each keyword runs as a separate search. |
| `searchQuery` | string | `""` | Single keyword (legacy, backward compatible). Use `searchQueries` for new integrations. |
| `location` | string | `""` | Department code or region code (e.g. `75` for Paris, `69` for Lyon). Empty = all France. |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | `100` | Per-keyword result cap (counts post-filter results when titleFilter is active). |
| `maxResults` | integer | `100` | Total cap across all queries. Set to `0` for unlimited. |
| `titleFilter` | string | `""` | Comma-separated title terms (case-insensitive substring OR-match). Applied after SERP fetch, before detail fetch. Non-matching rows are dropped entirely (no billing). Empty = no filter. Example: `Développeur, Chef de projet, Ingénieur`. |
| `sortBy` | enum | `"newest"` | `newest` = most recent first (tri=1); `relevance` = France Travail relevance ranking (tri=0). |
| `postedWithinDays` | integer | unset | Only return jobs posted within N days. Rounds up to the nearest discrete France Travail emission value: 1, 3, 7, 14, or 31. Values above 31 disable the filter. |
| `employmentType` | enum | unset | Filter by employment type. `FULL_TIME` = temps plein (dureeHebdo=1); `PART_TIME` = temps partiel (dureeHebdo=2). INTERNSHIP, TEMPORARY, CONTRACT, TRAINEE have no direct France Travail hours-type mapping and return all hours types. |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `false` | Fetch detail pages for full description, salary, and remote status. Slower but richer. |

### postedWithinDays rounding table

France Travail's `emission` param only accepts discrete day values. Your input is rounded up to the nearest option:

| Input | emission param | Window |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | Last 24 hours |
| 2-3 | 3 | Last 3 days |
| 4-7 | 7 | Last week |
| 8-14 | 14 | Last 2 weeks |
| 15-31 | 31 | Last month |
| 32+ | (omitted) | All offers |

## Output Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | France Travail offer ID |
| `title` | string | Job title |
| `company` | string/null | Hiring company name |
| `location` | string | Job location (city, department) |
| `country` | string | Always "FR" |
| `employment_type` | string/null | full-time, part-time, temporary, internship, apprenticeship, or contract |
| `remote_option` | string/null | remote, hybrid, or null |
| `salary_min` | number/null | Minimum salary (EUR) |
| `salary_max` | number/null | Maximum salary (EUR) |
| `salary_text` | string/null | Salary as displayed |
| `description_snippet` | string/null | Short description (max 500 chars) |
| `description_full` | string/null | Full description (detail mode only) |
| `posted_at` | string/null | Publication date (ISO 8601) |
| `source_url` | string | France Travail listing URL |
| `source_platform` | string | Always "francetravail.fr" |
| `search_query` | string/null | The search keyword that found this job |
| `scraped_at` | string | Scrape timestamp (ISO 8601) |

## Input Examples

### Basic search
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "developpeur",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Multi-query with location
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["developpeur", "ingenieur", "data scientist"],
  "location": "75",
  "maxResults": 200,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 100
}
```

### With full details (salary + description)
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["developpeur python"],
  "includeDetails": true,
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Scheduled daily scrape (recommended)
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["Developpeur"],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "postedWithinDays": 1,
  "employmentType": "FULL_TIME",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

### Title filter -- only senior roles
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["software"],
  "titleFilter": "Développeur, Ingénieur, Engineer",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Sort by newest
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["ingenieur logiciel"],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

### Sort by relevance
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["data scientist"],
  "sortBy": "relevance",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Precision title filter

Returns only French tech jobs whose title contains "développeur" or "ingénieur" (case-insensitive substring match). Non-matching SERP rows are dropped before the detail-fetch step, so you don't pay for job-detail events on jobs you don't want.

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["informatique", "logiciel"],
  "titleFilter": "développeur, ingénieur",
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

Example matched titles: "Développeur Full Stack React/Node.js", "Ingénieur Logiciel Embarqué".

### Jobs posted in the last week, full-time only
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["chef de projet"],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "postedWithinDays": 7,
  "employmentType": "FULL_TIME",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```
